The '''Marauder sword''' was a type of [[Sword/Legends|sword]] which was used by the [[Sanyassan Marauders/Legends|Sanyassan Marauders]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. This heavy sword was capable of inflicting terrible wounds.<ref>[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]</ref> The [[Sanyassan Marauders/Legends|Sanyassan Marauders]] known as [[Terak]] one during his in his dual against [[Noa Briqualon]] during the skirmish known as the [[Battle of Endor (Ewok–Sanyassan conflict)|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="Ewoks: The Battle for Endor">''[[Ewoks: The Battle for Endor]]''</ref>
